title: Quarterly phasing plan for Private deployment features with delivery waves and runbook
creator: Aisha Patel
description: High-level quarterly plan that breaks Private (VPC/on-prem) feature work into three delivery waves, ties each wave to OKRs, and produces a cross-team operational runbook for rollout and rollback. Focus is on staging, interop testing (RBAC/KMS/audit), and customer migration playbooks.
comments: 2026-02-28 - Kickoff: aligned with Eng, SRE, Security, and Solutions on three-wave approach. Agreed success metrics: latency SLO compliance in Dedicated vs Private <= +15% delta; migration time per customer < 3 days for standard templates.

2026-03-03 - Decision: split Wave 2 into feature-stability sprint and compliance sprint after Security requested extra time for KMS/HSM certification checks. Action: ENG to add a lightweight compliance smoke test to CI.
2026-03-05 - PRD linked: https://confluence.redwood.ai/private-deployments/q1-phasing (internal) — contains feature gating matrix and customer risk tiers.

2026-03-07 - Engineering note: batching/runtime changes in runtime-2.0 may affect startup time for on-prem images. Trade-off: accept higher cold-start for initial release to avoid blocking release cadence; follow-up optimization tracked in ENG-20988.

2026-03-09 - SRE/Observability: added rollout dashboards plan (Grafana dashboard stub) and alert thresholds for latency/error budget burn; dashboard PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/observability/pull/432.
2026-03-11 - UX/Docs: Solutions drafted customer migration playbook and template scripts for network config. Docs draft link: https://docs.redwood.ai/private/migration-playbook (internal).
2026-03-12 - Risk log: high-risk customers with strict FIPS/KMS requirements flagged. Need legal sign-off on data residency language prior to Wave 3 sales engagement.

2026-03-13 - Cross-team review: PM, Eng, Security, SRE agreed rollout windows and canary size. Action items: ENG to create canary rollback automation (sub-issue ENG-27721), Security to complete KMS checklist by 2026-03-25.
2026-03-14 - Updated timeline: Wave 1 (MVP release) targeted for 2026-04-15; Wave 2 (compliance & scale) target 2026-06-01; Wave 3 (enterprise integrations & migration tooling) target 2026-08-15.
